items.headline: Blizzard Warning issued November 12 at 3:33PM AKST until November 15 at 7:00AM AKST by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Blizzard conditions. Additional snow accumulations up to two
inches. Winds gusting as high as 45 mph through Friday, then 60 mph
Saturday into Sunday.

* WHERE...Central and Eastern Beaufort Sea Coast.

* WHEN...Until 7 AM AKST Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Travel could be difficult. Snow and blowing snow could
reduce visibility below one half mile at times. Periods of blizzard
conditions will be intermittently possible.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...We are expecting a lull in snowfall beginning
Frida
items.areas: Central Beaufort Sea Coast; Eastern Beaufort Sea Coast
items.instruction:
Travel should be restricted to emergencies only. If you must travel,
have a winter survival kit with you. If you get stranded, stay with
your vehicle.

items.headline: Dense Fog Advisory issued November 12 at 1:01PM AKST until November 13 at 12:00PM AKST by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Dense fog. Visibility one quarter mile or less at times.

* WHERE...Fairbanks North Star Borough, Nenana and Healy.

* WHEN...Until noon AKST Friday.

* IMPACTS...Low visibility could make driving conditions hazardous.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...As low clouds stick around, there will be
periods of dense fog through Thursday and into Friday.
items.areas: Upper Chena River Valley; Tanana Flats; Eielson AFB and Salcha; Goldstream Valley and Nenana Hills; Chatanika River Valley; Two Rivers; Fairbanks Metro Area; Nenana; Northern Denali Borough
items.instruction:
If driving, slow down, use your headlights, and leave plenty of
distance ahead of you.

items.headline: Winter Weather Advisory issued November 12 at 9:44AM AKST until November 13 at 6:00PM AKST by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Snow expected. Total snow accumulations up to 7 inches.

* WHERE...Kodiak Island Southwest.

* WHEN...From 6 PM this evening to 6 PM AKST Friday.

* IMPACTS...Travel could be difficult.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...The highest snow accumulations are more likely
towards Shelikof Strait, particularly Larsen Bay and Karluk.
items.instruction:
Slow down and use caution while traveling. For the latest road
conditions call 5 1 1 or visit 511.alaska.gov.

items.headline: Winter Weather Advisory issued November 12 at 9:44AM AKST until November 13 at 6:00PM AKST by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Snow and mixed precipitation expected. Total snow
accumulations from 2 to 10 inches.

* WHERE...Kodiak Island Northeast.

* WHEN...From 6 PM this evening to 6 PM AKST Friday.

* IMPACTS...Heavy snow and rain on snow may create difficult travel
conditions.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...A compact storm will move southeast of Kodiak
Island tonight and remain nearly stationary through Friday
afternoon to evening. Slight deviations in the storm position to
the east and west will cause snow levels
items.instruction:
Slow down and use caution while traveling. For the latest road
conditions call 5 1 1 or visit 511.alaska.gov.
